---
title: "Example report (Python)"
---

```{python}
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd

# png, so the chart also shows in the PDF
_ = alt.renderers.enable("png", scale_factor=2)

data = pd.DataFrame({
    "category": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C"],
    "value": [3, 5, 6, 8, 2, 4],
})
data.groupby("category").mean()
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(data).mark_point().encode(x="category", y="value")
```
